criteria.requirement: Build deepdiff.merge3.merge3(base,left,right,*,arrays="atomic") on the accepted JSON-tree validation and DeepDiff equality. Return Merge3Result(value,conflicts,complete) recursively combining disjoint dict edits, equal edits, additions and deletions. Explicitly distinguish absent from null. Preserve base at unresolved conflicts with exact component path and independent present/value snapshots for all three sides, never automatically choose left/right. Arrays are atomic business values, so index shifts or divergent arrays conflict; no speculative positional merge. Validate JSON/cycles, reject other array policies and preserve all inputs.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
